Question:
Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.

WITH top10_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name
    FROM customer
    WHERE customer_id IN (
        SELECT customer_id
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
        ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) as monthly_amount
    FROM payment p
    JOIN top10_customers t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_amount,
           LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_amount
    FROM monthly_totals
),
month_over_month_diff AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_amount - prev_month_amount as amount_change
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_month_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as customer_name,
       m.payment_month,
       ROUND(m.amount_change, 2) as amount_change
FROM month_over_month_diff m
JOIN customer c ON m.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY m.amount_change DESC
LIMIT 1

month_over_month AS (
    SELECT 
        m1.customer_id,

        m2.payment_month as previous_month,
        m2.monthly_total as previous_month_total,
